-08-31T16:36:29.200Z] [world] Something stirs in the dark of the place — a shape peeling itself up off the floor where the mud had set it.
[2026-08-31T16:36:29.201Z] [arbiter] The traders were right. Aetherkin. Some kneel to them; some burn them where they stand.
[2026-08-31T16:36:29.201Z] [world] In life it was a market-scribe, ink and silt run together down the front of them — you find yourself wanting to know their name, and knowing you never will. The mud took this house with them still inside it. They never reached the door.
[2026-08-31T16:36:29.202Z] [world] It doesn't lunge. It cringes back, arms up over its face — remembering, dimly, that living things once meant harm. It will only fight if you make it.

[2026-08-31T16:36:50.584Z] [world] You walk west through open silt. The compass tells you The Buried Cities lies further west — 3 tiles, about 8 hours of travel.
[2026-08-31T16:36:50.585Z] [world] A pre-flood Scrap Drone runs the same thirty-second patrol it was running the day the mud arrived. Six steps forward, scan, turn, six steps back, scan, turn. It has not been relieved. When its scanner cone passes over you it stutters — recognises a citizen-class signature that should not be here, then forgets it, then notices you again. The next pass it will not 
forget.
